comment: No source is published; the maker's page is at kilpatrickaudio.com/?p=virtue-vcv. The module declares one parameter with no name and no widget, so nothing there can be clicked. The three MIDI Output Mode choices are the literal strings CC, Piano Major and Piano Chroma, read from the expander's panel menu.
